SELECT death.caused_by_ship_id, ship.name
FROM death
JOIN ship ON death.caused_by_ship_id = ship.id
GROUP BY death.caused_by_ship_id, ship.name
ORDER BY SUM(death.injured) DESC
LIMIT 1;
